args: const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); function fail(msg){ process.stderr.write('[ado-mcp-launcher] ' + msg + '\n'); process.exit(1); } const need = ['AZURE_DEVOPS_AUTH_METHOD','AZURE_DEVOPS_DEFAULT_PROJECT','AZURE_DEVOPS_ORG_URL','AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT']; for (const k of need) { if (!process.env[k] || !process.env[k].trim()) fail('missing required env var: ' + k); } const authMethod = process.env.AZURE_DEVOPS_AUTH_METHOD.trim().toLowerCase(); if (authMethod !== 'pat') fail('unsupported AZURE_DEVOPS_AUTH_METHOD (expected pat)'); const orgUrl = process.env.AZURE_DEVOPS_ORG_URL.trim(); let org; let m = orgUrl.match(/^https:\/\/dev\.azure\.com\/([^\/]+)\/?$/i); if (m) { org = m[1]; } else { m = orgUrl.match(/^https:\/\/([^.\/]+)\.visualstudio\.com\/?$/i); if (m) org = m[1]; } if (!org) fail('invalid AZURE_DEVOPS_ORG_URL format'); const project = process.env.AZURE_DEVOPS_DEFAULT_PROJECT.trim(); const pat = process.env.AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT; const token = Buffer.from('mcp:' + pat).toString('base64'); const childEnv = Object.assign({}, process.env, { PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN: token, ado_mcp_project: project }); const result = spawnSync('npx', ['-y', '@azure-devops/mcp', org, '--authentication', authMethod], { stdio: 'inherit', env: childEnv }); if (result.error) fail('spawn error: ' + result.error.message); process.exit(result.status === null ? 1 : result.status);
